shared_elements: incised linear marks resembling script signs arranged in a roughly horizontal line
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry shallow, outline-incised linear signs set out in horizontal alignment, which is a very generic property of engraved sign-bearing surfaces. B additionally depicts a full figural scene — a standing figure facing a gesturing figure across an offering stand, framed above multiple ruled registers of text — while A shows only a handful of isolated, indeterminate scratched strokes with no identifiable figures, objects or relationships.
